Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Catan was published most recently based on the 2015 rebrand as "Catan," which was not relevant to the original task. The task specifically asked for the comparison of the original publication years of Pirate's Cove and Catan, not subsequent editions or rebrands. Pirate's Cove (2002) was published more recently than Catan (1995), and this error led to the wrong solution being marked as "TASK_COMPLETE."
